---
title: "HDI vs head motion correlation"
output: html_document
date: "2024-06-16"
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
df = read.csv("../Data/HDIs with metadata/HDIat01_w_meta_240910.csv")
df %>%
  summarise(correlation = round(cor(local_efficiency_bin, clustercoef_bin), 3))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(is_patient = recode(is_patient, '0' = 'HC', '1' = 'CBP')) %>%
  filter(time==1 & !is.na(n_spike_regs_sponpain)) %>%
  select(is_patient, n_spike_regs_sponpain, betweenness_bin, degree, clustercoef_bin, eigenvector_centrality_bin)

thresh = sd(df[df$is_patient == "HC", ]$n_spike_regs_sponpain) *3
LoMo <- df[(df$is_patient == "CBP") & (df$n_spike_regs_sponpain < thresh),]
HiMo <- df[(df$is_patient == "CBP") & (df$n_spike_regs_sponpain > thresh),]
LoMo$is_patient = "LoMo CBP"
HiMo$is_patient = "HiMo CBP"

merged <- rbind(df[df$is_patient == 'HC',], LoMo, HiMo)
merged$is_patient <- factor(merged$is_patient, levels=c("HC", "LoMo CBP", "HiMo CBP"))
```

```{r}
corr_tbl_be <- merged %>%
  group_by(is_patient) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = round(cor(n_spike_regs_sponpain, betweenness_bin), 3),
    p_value = cor.test(n_spike_regs_sponpain, betweenness_bin)$p.value)

corr_tbl_de <- merged %>%
  group_by(is_patient) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = round(cor(n_spike_regs_sponpain, degree), 3),
    p_value = cor.test(n_spike_regs_sponpain, degree)$p.value)

corr_tbl_cc <- merged %>%
  group_by(is_patient) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = round(cor(n_spike_regs_sponpain, clustercoef_bin), 3),
    p_value = cor.test(n_spike_regs_sponpain, clustercoef_bin)$p.value)

corr_tbl_ec <- merged %>%
  group_by(is_patient) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = round(cor(n_spike_regs_sponpain, eigenvector_centrality_bin), 3),
    p_value = cor.test(n_spike_regs_sponpain, eigenvector_centrality_bin)$p.value)

corr_tbl_be
corr_tbl_de
corr_tbl_cc
corr_tbl_ec
```

```{r}
plot_correlation <- function(which_hdi, hdi_name){
  ggplot(data = merged, aes_string(x = "n_spike_regs_sponpain", y = which_hdi, color = "is_patient")) +
        geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.01), size = 1.2) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
        labs(title = paste0(hdi_name, " HDI vs head motion"),
             x = "Head motion (sqrt scale)",
             y = "HDI") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(HC = "#E06B58", `LoMo CBP` = "#44E7E0", `HiMo CBP` = "#596DF4")) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = sqrt_trans(), 
    breaks = c(0, 10, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000), 
    labels = c("0", "10", "50", "100", "250", "500", "1000")) +
  # ylim(-0.2, 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # Remove grid lines
    panel.border = element_blank(),  # Remove border around plot
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size=1),  # Add black axis lines
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, face="bold"),  # Increase text size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),  # Bold axis titles
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),  # Larger and bold plot title
    legend.title = element_blank(),  # Bold legend title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")  # Decrease legend text size
  )
}

be <- plot_correlation(which_hdi = "betweenness_bin", hdi_name = "Betweenness")
de <- plot_correlation(which_hdi = "degree", hdi_name = "Degree")
cc <- plot_correlation(which_hdi = "clustercoef_bin", hdi_name = "Cluster Coefficient")
ec <- plot_correlation(which_hdi = "eigenvector_centrality_bin", hdi_name = "Eigenvector Centrality")


ggsave("../Graphs/correlation HDIs vs head motion/betweenness.png", be, width = 5, height = 2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../Graphs/correlation HDIs vs head motion/degree.png", de, width = 5, height = 2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../Graphs/correlation HDIs vs head motion/cluster_coef.png", cc, width = 5, height = 2, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../Graphs/correlation HDIs vs head motion/eigenvector_efficiency.png", ec, width = 5, height = 2, dpi = 300)
```
